name: photoroom_eggplant_staging
description: PhotoRoom Product Staging settings derived from templates/jewelry_eggplant_4x5.json
brand_style: Minimalist luxury jewelry photography with a beige and deep eggplant (aubergine) brand palette. High-end editorial studio look: soft diffused lighting with crisp metal highlights and gemstone sparkle, shallow depth of field, creamy background bokeh. Products sit on warm cream linen-textured display cushions. Backgrounds are rich matte eggplant with a subtle luxury gradient — no green or sage tones. Clean centered hero compositions with balanced negative space. Professional neutral color grading, realistic micro-reflections, extreme fabric and metal detail. Avoid cartoon or CGI looks, harsh shadows, clutter, text overlays, hands, models, or plastic oversaturation.
staging_prompt: Studio hero photograph of the jewelry on a warm cream linen display cushion, centered with balanced negative space. Deep eggplant matte background with a subtle luxury gradient. Soft diffused studio lighting from camera-right with gentle fill; background slightly darker than the product for premium contrast. Eye-level macro shot, sharp focus on metal texture and gemstones.

api.editWithAI_prompt_template: Make it a professional lifestyle photoshoot with the provided object or subject as the focus of the scene. {brand_style} {staging_prompt} Ensure the image highlights what is unique about the object. The lighting should create a natural and elegant atmosphere with excellent composition and a refined mood, achieving high-end jewelry photography.
